comment: FINAL: a continuous sweep of about 25 s with every segment at least 1.75 s long, plus a NEAR station (lift +23, elbow -24) and a FAR station (lift -24, elbow 0). Peak joint speeds pan 23.7, lift 14.0, elbow 9.0, wrist flex 22.9, roll 30.0 deg/s. Rows: seconds, pan, lift, elbow, wrist_flex, wrist_roll, in degrees from the home pose. The arm never holds still here, so fewer frames pass the solver's stillness rule than with close2.
